caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing human figure positioned on a two-tiered pedestal. The figure is dressed in a fringed tunic or dress with green, brown, and golden-yellow hues. The outfit includes a green sash tied at the waist, a necklace with green beads, and a circular medallion on the chest. The figure wears a brown headband, with shoulder-length dark hair and a light-colored cloth or feather draped over the left shoulder. The figure’s left arm is bent with the hand at waist height, palm facing up, and the right arm extends outward with the hand partially clenched. The footwear consists of green shoes. The pedestal is brown at the top tier and beige at the base, with inscriptions or names faintly visible on the slanted front face of the lower tier. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or scenery.
